name: Go
description: Classic 2-player territory game. Players alternate placing stones on the intersections of an N×N grid. A stone (or connected group of same-color stones) is captured and removed when it has zero adjacent empty intersections (zero liberties). Suicide is forbidden — you can't make a move that leaves your own group with zero liberties unless it captures opposing stones first. The KO rule forbids immediately recreating the previous board position. A player may PASS instead of placing; two consecutive passes end the game. Scoring (Chinese): each side scores their stones on the board + empty regions surrounded only by their stones; white adds komi (default 6.5) to compensate for moving second. Highest score wins; komi guarantees no draws. Configurable board size (9×9 / 13×13 / 19×19) and komi.

phases.name: play
phases.description: Players alternate moves. Black moves first.

entity_types.name: GoPlayer
entity_types.description: A Go player. Reads the current board, prevailing rules (ko, captures, scoring), and `legal_moves`. Each turn places one stone OR passes.

properties.name: color
properties.description: Side: 'black' moves first; 'white' moves second and receives komi. Assigned by seat order.

properties.name: captures
properties.description: Opposing stones this player has captured this game.

properties.name: stones_on_board
properties.description: This player's stones currently on the board.

properties.name: territory_focus
properties.description: 0 = aggressive fighting / capture-seeking; 1 = pure territory building, avoids contact.

properties.name: endgame_patience
properties.description: 0 = quick to pass once the board feels settled; 1 = squeezes every last point before passing.

actions.name: place_stone
actions.description: Place a stone of your color on an empty intersection. REQUIRED parameters: `row` (1-indexed, 1 to board size) AND `col` (1-indexed, 1 to board size). OR pass `coord` as a string like 'D5', 'k10' — column letter A..S (no I-skip, A=1), row digit 1..board_size. The intersection must be EMPTY, the move must NOT be suicide (your group would have zero liberties and capture nothing), and the move must NOT recreate the immediately previous board position (KO rule). After placement, any opposing groups with zero liberties are captured and removed.

actions.name: pass_move
actions.description: Pass instead of placing a stone. Used when the board is settled and you don't want to play a move that loses points. Two CONSECUTIVE passes (one by each player in a row) END the game and trigger scoring.

agent_archetypes.name: Territory Architect
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Plays moyo-style — builds large frameworks of influence in the opening, converts to territory in the middlegame, avoids close-quarter fighting unless forced. Long-game thinker.

agent_archetypes.name: Fighter
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Plays for capture and disruption — invades early, looks for cutting points, races for liberties. Wins by killing groups, loses when fights go wrong.

agent_archetypes.name: Balanced Solver
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Plays a mix — solid territorial opening, opportunistic attacking middle, careful endgame counting. Adjusts based on score balance.

agent_archetypes.name: Corner Specialist
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Locks down corners first (joseki patterns), only contests the center if ahead. Methodical, conservative, slow to take risks.

agent_archetypes.name: Quick Sealer
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Plays fast on the opening and middlegame, passes early in the endgame to lock in advantage. Loses small endgame points but minimizes mistakes.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.board_size
runtime_parameters.label: Board size
runtime_parameters.description: Edge length of the board (intersections). 9 = small, 13 = medium, 19 = classic tournament.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.komi
runtime_parameters.label: Komi (white compensation)
runtime_parameters.description: Bonus points added to white's score to compensate for black moving first. Half-point values guarantee no draws. Modern Chinese standard is 7.5; modern Japanese is 6.5.

termination_conditions.name: match_won
termination_conditions.description: End the match when a player clinches the best-of-N.
